subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

During Covid times, many organisations made _______ (sentimental) appeals to raise funds for migrant workers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sentimental"** refers to feelings of nostalgia, tenderness, or excessive emotion often tied to memories. (भावुक)

 
 
• **Example:** His sentimental attachment to his childhood home made it hard for him to sell it.
 
 
 
• **"Mawkish"** means excessively sentimental in a way that is insincere or overly emotional, often to the point of being cloying or unpleasant. (अत्यधिक भावुक या नकल करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The mawkish love story in the movie made some viewers uncomfortable due to its melodrama.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: "Sincere"** (ईमानदार): This refers to being genuine and free from pretense, which is not the same as being overly emotional or sentimental.

 
 
• **Example:** Her sincere apology was well received by everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "Cynical"** (निंदक): This refers to a belief that people are primarily motivated by self-interest and is not related to sentimentality.
 
 
• **Example:** His cynical view of politics led him to believe that no one was genuinely interested in making a difference.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "Practical"** (व्यावहारिक): Refers to something based on real-world applications or logic, which contrasts with emotional or sentimental appeals.
 
 
• **Example:** His practical approach to problem-solving helped streamline the project and deliver results on time.
